notes: IOI Corporation Berhad (1961.KL) — large integrated palm oil group with two reporting segments: Plantation (upstream FFB/CPO + own mills) and Resource-based Manufacturing (downstream — refining, oleochemicals, specialty fats; includes IOI Loders Croklaan). Fiscal year ends 30 June. Quarterly Form 8 announcements lodged with Bursa Malaysia. Acreage ~221,000 ha planted (~177,000 in Malaysia + ~44,000 in Indonesia) ≈ 546k acres, of which ~156k ha mature ≈ 386k acres carrying production. Biological assets carried at fair value under MFRS 141; FV gains/losses on produce and 50% associate (Bunge Loders Croklaan JV) flow through other operating income. Quarterly figures sourced from Bursa announcements; FY summaries from the 5-year financial highlights tables in the FY20-FY25 annual reports. EBITDA computed as PBT + finance costs + depreciation/amortisation (excluding share of associates' D&A where not disclosed). Net debt = total borrowings − cash & cash equivalents. Acreage held flat at 386k mature acres (~156k ha) across the period — minor variations within rounding. Some quarters show large FV gain swings on biological produce — captured in notes where material.
